findings.title: Missing planted-answer check is exported as verified
findings.input_change: Remove outcome.matches_planted from one otherwise verified record.
findings.observed: Packaging returned zero findings and emitted status=succeeded with verification.status=verified.
findings.cause: The verified predicate uses matches_planted != false, so missing and null values pass.
findings.required_fix: Require matches_planted == true for this known-answer cohort and add a negative test for missing, null, and false.

findings.title: Native analysis cost output and producer identity are not validated
findings.reproducer: The existing Fixture::refresh native output at tests/contracts.rs:73 omits aggregate_cells, streams, pair_rows, outcome_counts, qualified_ratios, analyzer binary identity, and analysis build receipt; complete_schema at tests/contracts.rs:88-105 still receives zero findings.
findings.observed: Only a schema string, manifest/count fields, three self-declared source hashes, and a mapping hash are checked. Most protocol-pinned analysis sources, analyzer binaries, and build receipt are not attached or verified.
findings.impact: An arbitrary or incomplete native summary can be attached as the canonical analysis output while copying expected hash strings, silently omitting or altering the cost results.
findings.required_fix: Validate a versioned native-output schema and all required 36-cell, stream, pair, outcome, null-qualification, plan, count, and missing-slot invariants; bind and attach the analyzer binary/build receipt and every applicable protocol source pin.

findings.title: All protocol-required warmups can be omitted without a finding
findings.input_change: Remove all three warmup executions and records, update the plan receipt hash, history, and native expected/observed slots from 18 to 15 while leaving protocol warmups=1.
findings.observed: Packaging and check_export returned zero findings with 15 measured rows and no warmup rows.
findings.cause: The plan receipt is trusted after schema/passed/file-hash checks, and lint_rows derives completeness from measured rows only.
findings.required_fix: Validate exact per-workload/per-arm warmup and measured cells against the frozen protocol and prepared-plan contract, including missing warmup findings.

findings.title: check_export does not validate its backend_record integrity fields
findings.input_change: Change backend_record.qualified to true, expected_execution_slots to zero, replace missing_slots with a fabricated slot, delete diagnostics, and replace native_analysis_sha256 with zeros.
findings.cause: The export schema permits an unconstrained backend_record object and check_export never validates the adapter-specific backend fields.
findings.required_fix: Bind a hash-bound packaging request or equivalent immutable inputs and reconstruct/compare the adapter-specific backend record, excluding only intentionally variable creation time.

findings.title: Counter values are neither required nor constrained to exact nonnegative integers
findings.input_change: Set counters.actual to the string not-a-nonnegative-integer.
findings.observed: Packaging returned zero findings and copied the string into measurements.counters.native.actual.
findings.cause: Every JSON string is accepted as a counter token; an absent or non-object counters field also iterates as an empty set.
findings.required_fix: Require the counter object and the declared finite counter inventory; accept only nonnegative integer JSON tokens or canonical decimal strings, preserving arbitrary width.

findings.title: Impossible restore metadata is accepted
findings.observed: Packaging returned zero findings and retained the impossible values.
findings.cause: The checks require nonnegative integers and a non-none policy but impose no protocol retry/restore bound or committed-generation relationship.
findings.required_fix: Do not assume each restore is a new logical attempt. Independently enforce applicable retry and max-restore limits, generations_written>=1 for a restore, restored generation within the committed range, and null restored generation when no restore occurred unless explicitly documented.

flow_assessment.note: flow.planned and flow.attempted intentionally describe observed canonical rows, while unattempted plan slots are kept in backend_record.missing_slots. The counts are not a defect by themselves. NCX-03 and NCX-04 show that the separate missing-slot ledger and warmup contract were not protected by check_export.

boundaries.note: The exporter intentionally forces wall_valid=false; this review does not treat absence of clock qualification as a hidden promise. Focused tests demonstrate current software behavior only and are not empirical research evidence.
